en: I jus' wanna help 'cause it don't make sense for Okudera-han or you folks to keep sufferin' for somethin' nine years past.
If Yama-oroshi takes me out, I want ya to get word to a man named Kosaka-han. He's the deputy warden of the prison.
Tell 'im that... I'm sorry I couldn't keep my promise.
Don't know about this.
Please. Don't make a report.
All right. But we can't help you.
Wait a second, Nishina-san! Why not?
Don't let your feelings get the best of you, Sakurai-san. We can't knowingly help a criminal. It's legally risky for us. You know that.
But after all he did...
I'm sorry, but I can't do anything more for you. I'm responsible for this village.
Doin' nothing is plenty. 'Preciate it.
(I might come across Yama-oroshi. Better get ready.)
Oh, hey. Listen, you got a minute?
Whaddya want?
Heard you're going hunting. Is it true?
So what if it is?
Well, could I trouble you to trap some martens?
Martens?
Yeah. They're like weasels.
They're my primary source of income, because the ones around here have such gorgeous fur.
But it's been so dangerous up there lately... and I don't have a gun⑬only traps. So it would be suicide for me to go up there.
So ya want me to get some for ya? Sorry, but I ain't riskin' my life for you.
But you're going up there anyway! And I'll pay you handsomely. Please, I'm begging you!
...Guess I'll nab some if I feel like it.
You will? You're a lifesaver! Three pelts is all I need. Thank you so much!
"Get Marten Pelts" was added to the list of missions.
(To catch martens, I'll hafta use cage traps.)
Oh, hey! Did you catch any martens?
You're a lifesaver, I swear! Oh, here's your payment right here.
Oh, thank you! My family will eat better because of you.
You handed over <Color:8>Marten Pelt<Color:Default>.
You got a <Color:8>Deer Meat<Color:Default>.
Thank you again!
Oh, I can see you have some pelts. They're not for me?
Okay, well, let me know if you ever have some for me...
I'm begging you to bag me three martens. Please? I'll wait right here.
I'm begging you⑬those marten pelts would mean so much to me. Please? I have your reward right here...
You got <Color:8>Deer Meat<Color:Default>.
I'm begging you to get me three marten pelts. I'll reward you. Please? I'm really in a bind here.
Well, if it ain't Kihachi-san. Hey, why the long face?
It's my wife.
She's laid up in bed, and so weak. The poor thing needs some nourishment.
What're ya thinkin' of gettin' her?
Bear meat. That's what would be best. But no one seems to have any.
Bear meat, huh?
Yeah. If you happen to shoot a bear, would you spare me some? I feel bad askin' for your help again, but my wife needs it.
"Get Bear Meat" was added to the list of missions.
I just wish I could get some bear meat for my wife...
Take this to her.
You handed over <Color:8>Bear Meat<Color:Default>.
Oh! She'll be so happy! Thank you for thinking of her.
Seems like every time we need something, you just pop up. Here's something to show how grateful I am.
It ain't no problem, but thanks all the same.
You got a <Color:8>Toughness ZZ<Color:Default>.
You're a great guy, Saejima-san.
Ah, but these days, no one hunts on the mountain. What am I going to do?
Oh, Saejima-san, I wanted to tell you how much my wife loved the bear meat! It really brought the color back into her cheeks.
Good to hear.
(Don't recognize this guy.)
Uh, excuse me? Are you from this village?
Uh, yeah. Guess so.
I beg your pardon. I just arrived from Tsukimino. My father's place is in the village.
And what, ya lookin' for his house?
Not exactly. I'm actually looking for a certain tree on the mountain. It's called the Ghost Pine.
Ain't heard of it.
I have a photo here. Do you recognize it?
Definitely an odd shape for a tree. What's so special 'bout it?
When my father was a child, he buried a time capsule there.
I want to dig it up, but I have no idea where that tree is. Plus, everyone here says it's too dangerous to even go on the mountain.
Don't yer father know where it is?
He passed away recently... That's why I came up here to find the capsule.
Sorry for yer loss.
It's fine⑬we weren't close. I've hardly thought of him in the thirty years since I left this village.
But when I heard he died, I suddenly thought of that time capsule.
I felt this urge to find it, and take it to his grave. I know it's just for my own satisfaction, hahaha. But...
(But death makes ya think, huh kid?)
Hey, lend me the photo.
Huh? Um. Why?
'Cause I wanna help ya. I still hunt on the mountain, despite the dangers. I might spot yer tree while I'm up there.
You're going to look for it?
I'll keep an eye out. Just don't expect too much.
Thank you so much! It means a lot to me.
You got <Color:8>Ghost Pine Photo<Color:Default>.
"Find the Time Capsule" was added to the list of missions.
My father said he buried his time capsule under a tree called the Ghost Pine. Please, it would mean a lot if you found it.
Sorry, I kept ya waitin'. Here's yer father's capsule.
You actually found it! Wow!
You handed over <Color:8>Time Capsule<Color:Default>.
Wonder what yer dad put in there as a kid?
Let's see...!
This should be interestin'.
It's a tin of candy, a round rock, lots of bottle caps, and... a little tin figurine.
Heh. Maybe not that interestin'. But they musta been real treasures to yer dad when he was a boy. Take 'em to his grave; his spirit'll get a kick outta them.
Yeah, why not.
Thank you so much, really. Maybe I'll finally get some closure with my dad.
Glad I could help ya.
Please take this as a token of my gratitude.
You got <Color:8>Lighter Oil<Color:Default>.
I've got to be going.
Take care.
Are you that outsider who got lost on the mountain?
That's me, ma'am.
Well, if you're healed now, then get out of town. Strangers bring nothing but trouble.
(Nice day to you, too.)
Mom, what are you doing? Let's go already.
Oh, it's the outsider.
Hold on. Are you two goin' up the mountain?
So what if we are?
Well, you goin' up is one thing, but yer ma's another. It's snowin' real hard. Could be risky.
Save it. We've always lived here. We don't need your advice.
(They gonna be okay? Hope I'm wrong about the danger...)
"The Outsider" was added to the list of missions.
You!?
What're ya doin' out here? Where's yer boy?
Mind your own business! Just leave me be!
This ain't no time fer pride. Where is he?
*heavy sigh*
We were picking wild plants when we came upon a bear.
We started running for our lives, and I lost sight of my son.
Okay. You're not hurt, are ya?
Don't worry about me. Worry about my son!
Fine, fine! Did ya happen to see the direction he went in?
I'm not sure, but I think he went deeper in.
Please, it's my son... Help him.
Do my best, ma'am.
I think my son is lost, somewhere deeper in the woods. Please help him.
Mother!
Oh, thank goodness!
I'm glad you're okay, Mom.
My precious son...
Oh, my poor boy... Where are you?
(Damn. Got separated. Gotta go back.)
(There he is.)
Hey, ya alright?
The outsider!
...Yer attitude seems to be alright, at least.
Have you seen my mother? We got separated.
Yeah. She's fine.
Ah, what a relief.
Yeah. Let's meet up with 'er and go back down.
Oh, um...
Hurry, before she wanders off lookin' for us.
Made it back. Hey, don't do anythin' that worries yer ma too much, eh?
Wait one moment!
I'm sorry for being so nasty to you. We owe you our lives. Thank you very much.
I also apologize.
Will you accept this? It doesn't come close to expressing the depth of our remorse, but...
You got <Color:8>5,000 yen<Color:Default>.
'Course I'll accept yer peace offerin'. Haha, I ain't exactly the trustin' type, myself.
"Your rice is too mushy!" she says... I'll make <Italic>her</Italic> into mush...
Somethin' the matter?
Oh dear, was I talking out loud?
How embarrassing. It's just... My mother-in-law is so awful! She complains about me in front of my Genzo, and⑬
In-law issues. Got it.
...So, I figured I'd make rabbit this evening. She <Italic>hates</Italic> rabbit meat.
What a shame we don't have any at home. Hey, aren't you staying at Okudera-san's? Has he taught you how to hunt?
Please, if you catch any rabbits, could you spare me some of their meat? I want to see her face when she bites into it.
I'll certainly reward you if you can help me get back at the old hag.
(Guess that's one way to get revenge.)
"Get Rabbit Meat" was added to the list of missions.
Ooh! Do you have rabbit meat for me?
Here. Though it sounds like you and yer mother-in-law need to⑬what's the phrase? Set some boundaries.
You handed over <Color:8>Rabbit Meat<Color:Default>.
The boundary is me getting back at her!
Here's your reward.
You got <Color:8>Carrot<Color:Default>.
Heh, we'll see how she likes <Italic>this</Italic>! Buh-bye!
Can you get me some rabbit meat? Pretty please?
Oh please, get me some rabbit meat. That crone deserves what's coming to her!
It was you, wasn't it? You gave my daughter-in-law that rabbit meat.
Oh, um, 'bout that...
Hehehe, don't squirm so much, big man. Makes you look like a fat worm on a hook! See, I lied when I told her I hated rabbit.
Yeah, I knew if I said that, the dingbat would fix up some rabbit for me. And I <Italic>love</Italic> rabbit. I could eat it every day!
Hehehe. Bunnies aren't the only ones who get caught in traps.
(Startin' to see the daughter-in-law's point.)
For being such a wonderful help, I'd like you to have this.
You got <Color:8>Rescue Card<Color:Default>.
Now I have to think of the next food I "hate."
(Why do women do this to each other?)
This can't go on. I have to get me some antlers!
...Nothing is <Italic>up</Italic>, thank you very much! You just don't understand.
Try me.
Well, it has to do with family harmony. I haven't been keeping up with my familial duty to my wife. If you... know what I mean by keeping it up.
So yeah, as a result, the old lady's feeling all kinds of neglected. Now she's giving me the silent treatment.
So stop neglectin' her.
Is it my fault the old boy's not so frisky anymore?
That's... a shame.
Sure is! So, let me hit you up with a proposition: deer antlers.
Uh, what's the connection?
You don't know? It's an age-old remedy for putting a little spring back into a man's step. It's not called a stag horn for nothing!
Ya really b'lieve that? Sounds like just an old wives' tale.
Well, I won't know for sure unless I try it! And seriously... I have to try <Italic>something</Italic>!
Glad I don't have this problem.
Great, then help another man out, would you? One antler's all I need. If you find one, pass it my way. Help make my home a happy place.
"Get an Antler" was added to the list of missions.
One antler's all I need... Help make my home a happy place!
Oh, hi! Sooo? Did you get the antler? To make me a panther?
Here. Have a good time with yer wife.
You handed over <Color:8>Antler<Color:Default>.
Ahaha, yes! This is it! You've saved our marriage!
And not a moment too soon. It's going to be a long night!
Here, take this in return.
All right, honey, here I come!
Sorry I made things worse, Sakurai-han.
I got cocky... Thought I could take on the mountain.
Well. I kinda figured a city-dweller wasn't going to take my words seriously.
But still, you're something else. You put your life on the line, without any hesitation. It's almost like...
Like what?
Uh, nothing. Just please take care. There's bravery, sure, but then there's recklessness.
True.
All right, I'm done lecturing you!
There's something else I want to talk to you about. See that man there? Do you know him?
He came here because he heard the rumors about a giant bear.
Must be Yama-oroshi.
Right. And look at that case on his back; there must be a huge rifle in there!
But how did he hear the rumors in the first place? When outsiders arrive one after the other like this, well... We townspeople get to wondering why.
Look, I don't know the guy.
Oh. I see. Well, if he's going after Yama-oroshi, that could be trouble...
So you're the other stranger in town.
What makes ya say that?
You really gotta ask? Take a look in the mirror sometime, buddy.
So... Are you after this bear, too?
Yama-oroshi?
Hah, I knew it! You are here for him. Well then, I guess we're rivals!
I'm Narumi. You might wanna remember my name and face, 'cause they're gonna be on the cover of every hunting magazine in Japan! And you are?
Saejima. Ya won't see it anywhere, if I'm lucky.
